confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief to confirm whether LH-06 is actually stopped (radio says stopped, CMMS says operating). No loader moves there until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C512-10, with a likely repair at 13:30. That stope has 136 t at 13.4 g/t, which is about 58.6 oz. Central trucks have spare capacity (91 t/h against 63 t/h inflow), so an extra loader is not truck-limited. LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading, which costs 0.5 oz/h, and takes 0.69 h to get there. At 29.1 t/h it clears the stope in about 4.7 h, so roughly 55 oz arrives before 17:00 for a cost of about 3 oz. I did not take LH-09, because its heading is worth 2.0 oz/h. I did not take LH-07, because C590-14 is a producing stope. LH-06 is under a radio/CMMS conflict, so per CONFIRM-01 nothing moves at N574-15 until the area chief confirms.
